description: Jev-routed web search: each query goes to the best specialised source (code, facts, news, prices), results ranked by relevance. 28/30 test queries answered. Up to 10 results per query, each with title, URL, snippet, short extract and publish date. Up to 5 queries per call, merged and de-duplicated. No account, no API key. Try GET /search/sample. Part of the AgentIndex content kit (pdf, web-read, extract, summarize, detect-language) - see GET /capabilities.

content_chars.description: Maximum Markdown characters returned per fetched result page.

content_results.description: How many top result pages to fetch when include_content is true.

extract.description: Include the search-engine snippet for each result.

include_content.description: Fetch result pages and include clean full-page Markdown. Defaults to true.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

query.description: Search query, or an array of up to 5 related queries to run in one call - results are merged and de-duplicated by URL.

summarize.description: Also return a short synthesized answer summarizing the results.

name: search

query.description: The query or queries that were searched.

results.description: Ranked web results, most relevant first.

content_error.description: Per-result fetch error; other search results remain usable.

content_markdown.description: Clean full-page Markdown for fetched top results, with navigation and boilerplate removed.

content_truncated.description: True when content_markdown reached the requested character limit.

summary.description: Optional short synthesized answer summarizing the results, when requested.

x402_receipt.description: Billing and provenance receipt for this call.

title: Web Search
